div.div:
the seed: what is configured
• cpp2cpp_validate
• cpp2cpp_wizard
• with a language xslt: cpp2cpp_before_xslt, your xslts, cpp2cpp_after_xslt
• your post xslts

div.div:
the catalog: eight edges (domain, state)
• gal2cpp GaL → CPP
• cpp2gal CPP → GaL
• cpp2xml CPP → XML
• xml2saxon XML → SAXON
• xml2cpp SAXON → CPP
• cpp2post_cpp LANGUAGE CPP → POST CPP
• post_cpp2post_xml POST CPP → POST XML
• post_xml2saxon POST XML → POST SAXON

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 970px; height: 1px; padding-top: 93px; margin-left: 1276px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #222222;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#222222, #d0d0d0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
builder_t
1. check the domain order (LANGUAGE, then POST_LANGUAGE)
2. check the catalog has the seven edges
3. before each seed step: breadth-first shortest path over the catalog, language part stays in LANGUAGE
4. language part done: append cpp2gal unless the last step is one
5. no post step: path to POST XML; a post xslt: path to POST SAXON

div.div:
The second gal2cpp is the way from GaL back to CPP for the post part. It is skipped at run time because language_state_ is set.
The testing path (prepare_testing_transforms) runs the builder with finish_sequence = false: the seed is only the flagged steps, and an edge is inserted only where two seed steps do not meet.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(251, 251, 251), rgb(21, 21, 21)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(204, 204, 204), rgb(62, 62, 62));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 2230px; height: 1px; padding-top: 635px; margin-left: 16px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #222222;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#222222, #d0d0d0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Domains: LANGUAGE (the language graph) → POST_LANGUAGE (the compiled view); cpp2post_cpp is the one edge that changes the domain, and there is no way back.
State types: GaL text · CPP the graph in memory · XML pugixml text · SAXON the document held for an xslt.
